Title: Paid Revenue amount overflows outside dashboard card boundary for large values
Preconditions: User logged in to team40 environment with Billing access and at least one bill payable
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://team40.qaaerp.com 2. Login with ID team40 and password vASPFtSh4d 3. Go to Billings and click New 4. Select an existing patient 5. In Billing Lines click Add a line and select existing service/medicine 6. Enter Quantity as 989 7. Enter Unit Price as 123456 8. Click Create Invoice 9. Click Confirm 10. Click Pay 11. Click Create Payment 12. Return to Dashboard
Expected Result: Paid Revenue value should remain fully contained within the Paid Revenue card with proper clipping/wrapping/scaling and no overlap outside card area.
Actual Result: Paid Revenue value renders beyond card width (text visually overflows outside the Paid Revenue card), causing UI breakage on the dashboard.
